summary_ja: 原則として勘定間の振替（トレーディング勘定とバンキング勘定間の商品の移し替え）を禁止し、取締役承認・内部監査・開示の3要件を満たす場合にのみ金融庁長官への事前届出により例外的に認める条文。
summary_en: Prohibits transfers between the trading and banking accounts as a general rule, permitting exceptions only when board approval, internal audit, and disclosure requirements are all met, subject to prior notification to the Commissioner of the FSA.
